from typing import Any


def _field(record: dict, name: str) -> Any:
    """Return a VRL field value; missing fields evaluate as an empty string."""
    return record.get(name, "")


def _nvl(value: Any, default: str) -> Any:
    """VRL NVL: empty or missing values use the supplied default."""
    return default if value == "" else value


def fire(state: str, event: str, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Dispatch one explicit case_lifecycle workflow event."""
    result_record = dict(record)
    audits: list[str] = []
    notifies: list[str] = []

    matched = False
    next_state = state
    actions: tuple[tuple[str, str, str | None], ...] = ()

    # Transition order is the source XML document order.
    if state == "N" and event == "assign" and _field(record, "OWNER_UID") != "":
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"
        actions = (("audit", "CASE_ASSIGN", None),)
    elif state == "N" and event == "auto_escalate":
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"
        actions = (
            ("set", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("set_nvl_sev", "SEV_CD", "3"),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        )
    elif state == "A" and event == "auto_escalate" and _field(record, "ESC_FLG") != "Y":
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"
        actions = (
            ("set", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        )
    elif state == "A" and event == "await_customer":
        matched = True
        next_state = "P"
        actions = (("audit", "CASE_PEND", None),)
    elif state == "P" and event == "customer_reply":
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"
    elif state == "A" and event == "resolve" and _field(record, "RES_DT") != "00000000":
        matched = True
        next_state = "R"
        actions = (("audit", "CASE_RES", None),)
    elif state == "R" and event == "close":
        matched = True
        next_state = "X"
        actions = (("audit", "CASE_CLOSE", None),)
    elif state == "R" and event == "reopen":
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"
        actions = (
            ("set", "RES_DT", "00000000"),
            ("audit", "CASE_REOPEN", None),
        )

    if not matched:
        return {
            "state": state,
            "record": result_record,
            "audits": ["WF_NOMATCH"],
            "notifies": [],
            "matched": False,
        }

    for action, value, extra in actions:
        if action == "set":
            result_record[value] = extra
        elif action == "set_nvl_sev":
            result_record[value] = _nvl(_field(result_record, value), extra or "")
        elif action == "audit":
            audits.append(value)
        elif action == "notify":
            notifies.append(value)

    return {
        "state": next_state,
        "record": result_record,
        "audits": audits,
        "notifies": notifies,
        "matched": True,
    }
